# v0.23.3-rc2 — retained conversation compaction

This candidate repairs retained-conversation compaction and replay while preserving original messages and source ownership. It is a prerelease; stable promotion requires the release gauntlet for this exact code tree.

## Highlights

- Compaction uses the same conversation ownership rules when selecting source messages, validating publication and assembling summaries.
- In-place continuation and systemless restored histories retain committed coverage without ingesting the old transcript again.
- Fresh repeated tool executions remain distinct across producer sessions. Ambiguous duplicate occurrences retain their raw context instead of receiving guessed summary lineage.

## Fixes

- Preserve a standalone generated summary as a summary carrier during host message repair.
- Include admitted legacy whitespace-owned rows in publication coverage.
- Preserve proven legacy attribution across repeated rollovers and reject conflicting session reuse without changing source ownership fields.
- Count replay occurrences in order so repeated requests and tool executions remain distinct; require source lineage for registered snapshot extensions.
- Retain existing explicit source proofs and the recent conversation tail when publication cannot proceed.
- Includes the prior maintenance changes: cached FastEmbed warmup, linear Teams scope backfill and session-end prefix-matching extraction. See the repository changelog for contributor credit and details.

## Compatibility and boundaries

No schema migration, conversation reset or vector rebuild is required. Existing privacy settings remain in effect.

Telegram replay also needs the narrow [Hermes summary-marker correction](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/pull/106353). Qualification pins a host containing that correction; this candidate does not update Hermes automatically.

An ambiguous source occurrence can cause compaction to preserve raw input and refuse publication. That refusal is not successful compaction. This release does not certify every retained deployment or resolve unrelated recall ranking issues.

## Release verification

The source repair is tracked in [LCM-X PR458](https://github.com/electricsheephq/lcm-x/pull/458). Phase A tool/embedding/privacy checks, Phase B independent release-diff and upgrade checks, and Phase C live ACP compaction/recall must pass before GA. Earlier candidate receipts do not qualify this changed product tree.
